Supports the RTL image flipping range and effect.

The simulator supports only some RTLs. The actual effect is subject to the actual RTL (Minimum version: 24.12. 0)

Runtime built-in components: (picker, switch, radio, and input display)

  1. Progress

  2. Button

  3. Checkbox

  4. Picker

  5. picker-view

  6. label

  7. switch

  8. radio

  9. textarea

  10. input

The effect of the textarea and input components on Android and iOS is the same as that of the input boxes in their systems.

  2. empty

  3. field

  4. loading

  5. overlay

  6. popup

  7. toast
